moving into a chosen gap avoids columns, while standing in their real area hurts
ongoing ultimate, delayed thunder, ward, growth and guardian phases restore
pause freezes new combat clocks and does not spend charges

v3 save routes to the exact preserved v3.0.2 entry

death wins the same-tick boundary over a later ring hit, without creating zero-health victory
